newsitem.title: USA: MCA names Platt president of unit.
newsitem.headline: MCA names Platt president of unit.

text.p: MCA Inc Tuesday named former Sony Pictures executive Marc Platt to the post of president of production for its Universal Pictures unit.

In a statement, Universal Pictures Chairman Casey Silver said Platt will be responsible for the development and production of all feature film projects for Universal Pictures. He will report directly to Silver.
Platt comes to Universal from TriStar Pictures, one of the studios under Sony Corp's Sony Pictures unit. Platt served as president of TriStar since February 1992.

During his tenure at TriStar, he was responsible for such films as Nora Ephron's "Sleepless in Seattle," Jonathan Demme's "Philadelphia," Edward Zwick's "Legends of the Fall," and 1995's holiday blockbuster, "Jumanji."
Mr. Platt will join Universal Pictures on September 9 based at Universal Studios in Universal City, California. MCA is 80 percent owned by Seagram Co Ltd.
